## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三处让每晚 CLI e2e 变红的地方。`os audit verify` 里打印拒绝信息的小函数挪到读 `--json` 的主体之后（只是挪位置，行为不变）；`os g object` 的桶文件测试改为期望具名导出；jsx 页面测试的夹具页写明 `type: 'home'`，单测里的同款夹具一并对齐。
- 为什么改：三个合并（#32473 带进 `audit verify`、#32389 改了生成器写法、#32471 开始拒绝空记录页）各自让一个只在夜间跑的 e2e 文件过时，夜间检查连续报红（#32395）。
- 风险与回滚：极低。产品代码只有一处方法换位置，输出、退出码、两种界面全都不变；其余是测试期望与夹具。只动 `packages/cli`，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/audit/verify.ts`（`refuse()` 的新位置）；`packages/cli/test/jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e.test.ts` 的 `TOP_FULL`；`packages/cli/test/generate-skill.e2e.test.ts` 末尾的桶文件断言。
- 两分钟验证：在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm exec vitest run test/diff-usage-error-stream.e2e.test.ts test/generate-skill.e2e.test.ts test/jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e.test.ts`，预期 3 个文件 68 条全绿（main 上是 6 条红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；下一次夜间检查转绿后卡片自行关闭。

Part of #32395 — this PR fixes all three red files the nightly names; the card stays open and closes itself when the next nightly sweep is green.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none

## What changes

Three commits, `packages/cli` only, one `@objectstack/cli` patch changeset (for the leg-1 move).

1. **`os audit verify` (`src/commands/audit/verify.ts`).** The private `refuse()` helper (human face: `printError` to stdout; `--json` face: the compact envelope) moves, unchanged, from between `run()` and `verify()` to below `verify()`. Its docblock now says why it sits there. `diff-usage-error-stream.e2e.test.ts` › "no new command has grown a stdout write above its --json guard" judges a `--json` command by line position (no print call between `run()` and the first read of `flags.json`), and the helper sat in that span since the command landed in bddd5152 (#32473). This is the layout the `migrate` one-shot siblings use: `run()` directly above the body method whose first lines read `--json`. Behaviour is byte-identical: every refusal text, its stream and its exit status 2 are unchanged on both faces.
2. **`generate-skill.e2e.test.ts`.** The barrel-line pin expects `export { customer } from './customer.object';`. The generator moved on purpose in 0dac4dcf (#32389, `exportsByName` on the `object` generator, the starter's barrel shape); this nightly-only pin kept the default-export literal. The property it guards (the barrel names the module really written, not `'./customer'`) is unchanged.
3. **`jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e.test.ts` and its unit twin `src/utils/sdui-manifest.test.ts`.** The round-1 top-level page gains `type: 'home'`. f0f729e7 (#32471) refuses at parse a `kind: 'full'` page of the default `record` type that places no component, and this fixture left `type` out, so `os validate` / `os build` exited 1 at the page before the gate ran (4 legs). It is a home page by name and label, and it stays the top-level `kind: 'full'` page the layout needs. The unit twin carries the same page; it stayed green only because it is never parsed, and is aligned so the two agree (seat ruling).

## Why

The `e2e` / `live` tiers run only nightly on `main`, so a PR that moves a generator or narrows a spec rule cannot red them on its own run. Nightly run 43162160955 on `67c49d77` named these three files; they were reproduced on `main` `0f9b5653` (3 files failed, 6 tests failed, 62 passed) before any edit.

## Tests

The three named files are the pins; no new test file. Leg 1 is the one code change and carries the one ablation (below). Legs 2 and 3 change test expectations only: their "red before" is the reproduction on `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/cli/test/serve-organization-record-page.e2e.test.ts:57` also carries a `type: 'record'` page with `regions: []`, bound to `sys_organization`. It is not red (the serve path still registers it) and is left as it is by the seat's ruling.
- No allow-list or skip was added; no test was renamed, skipped or deleted.

## Verification

All readings on head `7faad8bd2` (the three commits with `origin/main` `3452dec21` merged) unless named. `main` has moved further since that merge; none of the later commits touches `packages/cli` (seat check at review).

<details><summary>The three named pins, red on main and green here (OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly)</summary>

From `packages/cli`: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm exec vitest run test/diff-usage-error-stream.e2e.test.ts test/generate-skill.e2e.test.ts test/jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e.test.ts`, after building the CLI closure.

- On `main` `0f9b5653`: Test Files 3 failed (3), Tests 6 failed | 62 passed (68). These are the six legs the nightly names: "finds none" (`[ 'audit/verify.ts' ]`), the barrel line, and the four "a top-level kind:full page" legs (validate and build, notice and malformed).
- On `7faad8bd2`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 68 passed (68). The lock's VERDICT is command-exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the leg-1 code move)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/commands/audit/verify.ts` planted the old helper back between `run()` and `verify()`, with its text unchanged and renamed `refuseAblated32395`. The mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `a6102a0cad56` to `b0c7e08ef1ba`. `diff-usage-error-stream.e2e.test.ts` then gave Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12), and the one red was "finds none": `expected [ 'audit/verify.ts' ] to deeply equal []`. The restore left blob == HEAD (`a6102a0cad56`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. The scan reads `src/` text directly, so no `dist/` leg applies. Legs 2 and 3 change test expectations only, and their red is the reproduction on `main` above.
</details>

<details><summary>CLI suite, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` on `947b76146` (the three commits before the merge; the merged `3452dec21` also changed `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`, outside this diff, so the unit suite on the merged head is left to per-PR CI): Test Files 411 passed of 413, Tests 5877 passed | 29 skipped. The two other files refused to start because `packages/cli` was not built yet ("./dist/index.js is absent", their own prerequisite). After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli` both passed: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 29 passed. The `integration` layer is declared to CI. The diff touches no spawn entry, only two nightly `.e2e` files, and those ran above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0 on `7faad8bd2`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 68)</summary>

All 68 exit 0 on `7faad8bd2`, with codes captured before any pipe. `dispatch-gates --ran` reports "68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". On the first pass two exited 3 (prerequisite not met): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow history, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` with no `dist/` for unbuilt packages. Both exit 0 after `git fetch --unshallow` and a workspace build (`turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`).
</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood (under os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` on `7faad8bd2`: VERDICT command-exit 0. Test Files 451 passed | 3 skipped (454), Tests 3780 passed | 42 skipped (3822).
</details>
